tenderSchedule.title: Agency for Providing Bird Scares Services
tenderSchedule.description: Selection of an Agency for Providing Bird and Animal Scaring and Allied Services in the Operational Area at Vijayapura Airport, Vijayapura District for KSIIDC
tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka State Industrial Infrastructure Development Corporation

tenderAddress.blockNumber: KSIIDC No 49 Khanija bhavan 4th floor Racecourse Road

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
Any document uploading shall be made in the corresponding parts only as specified in the RFP document

All required original documents shall be scanned and uploaded in e-procurement. Failure to upload any document in e-proc will be considered as non responsive. The Bidders shall submit all the original documents uploaded as per RFP conditions.
No Interest will be paid for EMD (Bid Security)
KSIIDC reserves the right to accept or reject any of the tenders without assigning any reasons thereof.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Years of Experience The Bidder should have at least 3 (three) years of experience as on the date of notice inviting tender in providing Manpower services for Central Government / State Government or its entities / Public Sector clients.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certification of Incorporation, Technical Proposal Submission Form at Section 3A , Details of the Bidder at Section 3I

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience in Providing Manpower Services for Bird Scarers The Bidder should have experience in undertaking at least one (01) assignment on deployment of manpower services for Bird Scarer at an Airport having a minimum contract value of Rs. 20 Lakhs (Rupees Twenty Lakhs only) for a Central Government / State Government or its entities / Public Sector clients
Not Blacklisted / Barred and Not Involved in Major Litigation Affecting Service Delivery

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Technical Proposal Submission Form at Section 3A

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Average Annual Turnover The Bidder should have had an average annual turnover of at least INR 20 Lakhs (Rupees Twenty Lakhs only) for the last 5 (five) complete financial years (i.e., FY 2021- 22, FY 2022-23, FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26). For the avoidance of doubt, the financial year shall, for the purposes of a Bid hereunder, mean the Accounting Year followed by the Bidder in the course of its normal business.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: 3C. Comments and suggestions on the Terms of Reference and on data, services, and facilities to be provided by the Client.
3D. Description of the methodology and work plan for performing the assignment.
3F. Format of Curriculum Vitae of proposed key personnel
3G. Power of Attorney of Authorized Signatory
Agency should have BCAS registration certificate or shall submit the application for getting the BCAS registration certificate along with declaration letter
Self-attested copy of valid license from Labour Department to engage in business of Manpower Agency
Valid Registration with EPFO under EPF & Miscellaneous Provisions Act 1952
